title: The Global Influenza Hospital Surveillance Network: A Multicountry Public Health Collaboration

locators.F03: Abstract; Data Availability Statement; governance section

methods: Network description paper (Influenza Other Respir Viruses 19(3):e70091).
findings: >100 hospitals in 27 countries; 168,639 hospitalized patients enrolled as of Oct 2023; 27,562 influenza and 44,629 other respiratory virus detections; seasons from 2012-13.
Standard core protocol: demographics, comorbidities, pre-admission symptoms and management, in-hospital severity, treatment, outcomes; PCR testing, WGS subset shared via GISAID.
Data statement: anonymized data available on request to contact@gihsn.org; use requires approval of an analytical proposal by the Independent Scientific Committee; sites can opt out.
limitations: Age >=65 counts only in Figure 3 (not read); ICU/IMV/death are not listed as core fields in the text.
notes: Page text beyond 100k characters not read.

title: Homekit2020: A Benchmark for Time Series Classification on a Large Mobile Sensing Dataset with Laboratory Tested Ground Truth of Influenza Infections
methods: CHIL 2023, PMLR 209. Benchmark of nine time series classifiers, 450 training runs.
findings: Over 14 million hours of minute-level multimodal Fitbit data with symptom reports and laboratory PCR influenza results.
limitations: Abstract does not give participant count, PCR-positive count or age range.

title: behavioral-data/Homekit2020 (GitHub README)
findings: Access: register on Synapse, request approval on wiki syn22803188 (processing may take several business days), then `synapse get syn51476306`.
limitations: README does not state DUA terms or eligibility.

title: Self-supervised Pretraining and Transfer Learning Enable Flu and COVID-19 Predictions in Small Mobile Sensing Datasets
methods: Same Evidation flu study Fitbit data.
findings: Data from 5,196 participants over six months; participants reporting cough plus one other symptom self-swabbed for mailed PCR.
limitations: Seen only as search snippet; not confirmed to be identical to the released Homekit2020 cohort.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03684044: Baloxavir Marboxil + Standard-of-Care NAI in Hospitalized Participants With Severe Influenza (FLAGSTONE, CP40617)

locators.F02: API v2 fields IPDSharingStatementModule, EnrollmentInfo, EligibilityModule

findings: Sponsor Hoffmann-La Roche; completed 2020-03-16; actual enrollment 363; minimum age 12, no maximum.
IPD sharing YES: qualified researchers may request individual patient level data through Vivli; Roche criteria at vivli.org/ourmember/roche/.
limitations: Enrollment 363 in registry vs 366 in publication abstract (S072).

title: Combining baloxavir marboxil with standard-of-care neuraminidase inhibitor in patients hospitalised with severe influenza (FLAGSTONE)
findings: 366 enrolled Jan 8 2019 to Mar 16 2020 (241 baloxavir, 125 control); median time to clinical improvement about 97.5 h vs 100.2 h; no superiority.
limitations: Seen via search snippet only; full author list not checked.

title: Vivli data request 8896: Treatment of baloxavir marboxil in immunocompromised patients with influenza infection
methods: Public listing of a Vivli request.
findings: Request lists CAPSTONE-2 (NCT02949011) and FLAGSTONE (NCT03684044) with Roche as data contributor, i.e. both trials are requestable together on Vivli.
limitations: Direct fetch returned 404; request status not seen.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02949011: Baloxavir vs Placebo or Oseltamivir in Patients at High Risk of Influenza Complications (CAPSTONE-2)
findings: Sponsor Shionogi; completed 2018-04-20; actual enrollment 2,184; minimum age 12; outpatients at high risk of complications.
limitations: Registry record has no IPD sharing module; Vivli availability inferred from S073.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01231620: Intravenous Zanamivir Versus Oral Oseltamivir in Adults and Adolescents Hospitalized With Influenza
findings: Sponsor GlaxoSmithKline; actual enrollment 626 hospitalized patients; IPD statement: patient-level data available through clinicalstudydatarequest.com.
limitations: CSDR vs Vivli as current route not confirmed (S081).

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01014988: Safety Study of IV Zanamivir for Treatment of Influenza in Hospitalized Patients
findings: Sponsor GlaxoSmithKline; actual enrollment 202 hospitalized patients; IPD via clinicalstudydatarequest.com.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02287467: Anti-Influenza Hyperimmune IVIG in Adults Hospitalized With Influenza (INSIGHT 006 FLU-IVIG)
findings: Sponsor NIAID; 2015-01 to 2018-06-07; actual enrollment 329; age >=18.
limitations: No IPD sharing module; no public request channel found (AccessClinicalData@NIAID returned 403).

title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03376321: Pimodivir + SOC in Adolescent, Adult, and Elderly Hospitalized Participants With Influenza A
findings: Sponsor Janssen; terminated; 2018-01-03 to 2020-04-30; actual enrollment 334; age 13-85. Companion outpatient high-risk trial NCT03381196: 553 enrolled, age 13-85.
limitations: No IPD sharing module; YODA Project site search for pimodivir returned no results (S079).

title: YODA Project site search: pimodivir
findings: No results for pimodivir.
limitations: Site search may not index all trials; not checked via 'Trials by Generic Name'.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search: influenza, IPD sharing YES, interventional, older adults, hospitalized/severe/high risk, completed or terminated
methods: query.cond=influenza; query.term=AREA[IPDSharing]YES AND AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (hospitalized OR hospitalised OR severe OR "high risk") AND AREA[StdAge]OLDER_ADULT; status COMPLETED|TERMINATED.
findings: 141 records, mostly vaccine trials; after removing vaccine titles, treatment trials in hospitalized influenza with IPD sharing: NCT01231620 (GSK, 626), NCT01014988 (GSK, 202), NCT01527110 (GSK, 21), NCT03684044 (Roche, 363), NCT03315104 (Emergent, 65, statement does not promise IPD).
limitations: Keyword filter can miss trials; trials without an IPD statement (e.g. CAPSTONE-2) are excluded by design.

title: CASRAI page on GSK moving patient-level data requests from CSDR to Vivli
findings: States that as of 2023 GSK directs new patient-level data requests to Vivli instead of ClinicalStudyDataRequest.com.
limitations: Secondary source; not confirmed on GSK or CSDR sites.

title: ISARIC: Data Access and Collaboration
findings: Written for ISARIC Partners: submit a Statistical Analysis Plan to data@isaric.org, then sign a data access agreement.
Details given for COVID-19 data; influenza or seasonal SARI datasets not listed; data may not be held outside Oxford University servers beyond the agreement end date.
limitations: External (non-partner) route for COVID data goes through IDDO Data Access Committee; influenza route not described.

title: Progression of whole-blood transcriptional signatures from interferon-induced to neutrophil-associated patterns in severe influenza
findings: England, 1 Dec 2009 to 3 Mar 2011, London and Liverpool hospitals; 131 adults with confirmed influenza analysed.
Severity at T1: 1 = SpO2 >93% on room air; 2 = SpO2 <=93% needing supplemental oxygen with or without CPAP/NIV; 3 = IMV with or without ECMO (2010/11: 47/34/28).
T1 at recruitment, T2 about 48 h later; mean age 41 (17-71) in 2010/11. Raw and normalized microarray data in GEO GSE111368.
limitations: Young cohort; per-sample severity metadata in GEO not verified (GEO page blocked by bot check).

title: OmicsDI: GSE101702 Host response to IAV infections in human patients
findings: 154 influenza patients; blood within 24 h of hospital presentation; WGCNA modules ranked by contribution to progression and fatality.
limitations: Severity breakdown, country and publication not shown on the record.

title: Serum bicarbonate and 30-day mortality in critically ill influenza patients (MIMIC-IV v2.2)
findings: 276 critically ill influenza patients identified in MIMIC-IV v2.2 ICU; 30-day mortality 15.5%.
limitations: Index listing only (direct fetch 403); case definition not seen.
notes: 摘要级。用于估计量级，正式口径以服务器实测为准。

title: China Kadoorie Biobank Data Access and Sample Preservation Policy
methods: Official policy (fetch returned 403; content from search snippets).
findings: Welcomes proposals from researchers in China and worldwide; reasonable requests from bona fide researchers presumed granted; online Data Access System; Data Access Agreement (open access) or Collaboration Agreement; Independent Access Committee.
Genotype data constrained by Chinese human genetic resources rules.
limitations: Fees, dataset list and export terms not seen.

title: The hospitalization burden of all-cause pneumonia in China: a population-based study, 2009-2017 (CKB)
methods: Lancet Reg Health West Pac 2022; CKB linked to health insurance.
findings: 506,086 CKB participants alive in 2009; pneumonia admissions via insurance through 2017; 8.4 per 1000 person-years. A 2018 IJPDS paper reports 97.7% of insurance events coded to ICD-10.
limitations: Search snippets only; influenza-specific (J09-J11) counts not reported.

title: Influenza-Associated Hospitalizations During a High Severity Season - FluSurv-NET, United States, 2024-25 Influenza Season (MMWR 74(34))
methods: Population-based surveillance, sampled medical chart review, weighted proportions.
findings: Age 65-74 (n=1,655): ICU 17.2%, IMV 7.3%, in-hospital death 3.3%. Age >=75 (n=2,854): ICU 13.3%, IMV 4.3%, death 4.5%.
About 300 acute care hospitals in selected counties of 14 states, about 9% of the U.S. population; cumulative hospitalization rate highest in >=75 (598.8 per 100,000).
limitations: Preliminary data; aggregate tables only.

title: CDC FluView: Influenza Hospitalization Surveillance Network (FluSurv-NET) overview
findings: Hospitalization rates by age and patient characteristics published on FluView and FluView Interactive.
limitations: No public route to individual-level FluSurv-NET records found.

title: Emergency Department Visits With an Influenza Test Ordered or Provided: United States, 2013-2022 (NCHS Data Brief 517)
findings: ED visits with influenza test rose from 2.5% (2013) to 10.9% (2022); for age >=65 from 1.5% to 9.6%. NHAMCS ED public-use files downloadable (SAS/Stata); diagnosis codes truncated to 4 digits.
limitations: Visit-level sample survey, no follow-up beyond ED disposition.

title: All of Us Research Program update (NIH DPCPSI Council, Sep 2024)
findings: Open to national and international researchers; 135+ international institutions registered; institution must sign a Data Use and Registration Agreement.
limitations: Whether non-US researchers get controlled tier not confirmed.

title: WHO Global Influenza Programme: FluNet and FluID
findings: FluNet: weekly virological surveillance by country via GISRS, downloadable reports. FluID: epidemiological (ILI/SARI) data.
limitations: Download steps not opened.

title: CPRD approved study: Risk of hospitalised influenza in England 2000-2017

limitations: Access terms and fees not checked.

title: ImmPort Data Release 59 notes
findings: Multi-country influenza study: samples from 1,705 healthy or influenza infected subjects, 5 countries; outcomes include symptom severity, viral load, shedding duration. ImmPort download needs free registration.

title: PhysioNet content search: influenza
findings: No resources matched 'influenza': PhysioNet has no influenza-specific database; influenza cohorts must be cut from general EHR databases.
limitations: Topic search depends on project keywords.

title: FLAGSTONE protocol CP40617 version 2 (NCT03684044 Prot_000.pdf)

locators.F02: Objectives and endpoints table (p.13); inclusion criteria; Sec 4.5.4 Vital Signs (p.43); Sec 4.5.16 Ordinal Scale (p.47)

findings: Inclusion: hospitalized, influenza by RIDT or RT-PCR, onset-to-randomization <=96 h, NEWS2 >=4, plus ventilation/supplemental oxygen or an influenza complication requiring hospitalization.
6-point ordinal scale (discharged / ward no O2 / ward O2 or NIV / ICU without IMV / IMV / death) recorded at baseline and once daily every morning while hospitalized.
Vital signs (RR, pulse, SpO2, SBP, DBP, temperature; O2 flow or FiO2 if on oxygen) recorded four times per day Day 1-10 while hospitalized, daily for those still hospitalized from Day 11.
Secondary endpoints include incidence of IMV and ICU stay, time to clinical failure (death, IMV or ICU admission = ordinal 6/5/4), mortality at Day 7 and Day 28.
limitations: Protocol, not the delivered dataset; actual Vivli variables to be confirmed in the data dictionary.
